about.seoDescription: Meet YIPAI Textile, a performance outdoor fabric manufacturer and integrated textile production company based in Suzhou, China.
about.heroText: Performance outdoor fabrics for apparel teams building for demanding environments.
about.whoTitle: Performance Outdoor Fabrics for Technical Apparel.
paragraphs: YIPAI TEXTILE is a performance outdoor fabric manufacturer and integrated textile production company based in Suzhou, China.
We work with outdoor apparel brands, garment manufacturers and international fabric buyers to discuss functional materials for ski wear, hiking apparel, shell jackets, outdoor pants and workwear.

Our work includes waterproof breathable constructions, nylon stretch fabrics, abrasion-oriented options and PFC-free water-repellent finishing strategies. Fabric specifications are developed around each application brief.
about.benefitText: An integrated textile partner for apparel teams developing functional outdoor products.

productDetail.customized: Available specifications can be customized according to application requirements.
productDetail.shareSpec: Share your target specification and our team can discuss suitable options.
productDetail.pfcContext: PFC-free options can help brands move toward fluorine-free water-repellent finishing strategies. Water repellency, breathability and application requirements should be considered together for each fabric brief.
productDetail.generalContext: Start with your garment, environment and target requirements. YIPAI Textile can discuss suitable fabric constructions and development options for this application.
productDetail.finishingTitle: Develop and evaluate to the brief.
productDetail.finishingText: Finishing options can be discussed according to the garment application and target requirements. Technical fabric evaluations can use applicable methods agreed during development.
productDetail.ctaText: Tell us the target application, construction and performance requirements for your project.

applicationDetail.customizable: Available specifications can be customized according to application requirements.
applicationDetail.ctaText: Share your target performance and construction. We will help you explore suitable fabric solutions.

context.ski-wear: Ski garments may combine technical shell construction with weather protection, breathability, wind protection and mobility. Share the expected conditions, garment zones and low-temperature use context for fabric selection.
context.hiking: Hiking apparel may need to balance weather protection, moisture vapor movement, abrasion requirements and comfort through sustained movement in changing conditions.
context.outdoor-jackets: Outdoor jackets range from light layers to technical shells. Define the intended layering system, weather exposure, hand feel and construction before selecting a fabric.
context.outdoor-pants: Outdoor pants briefs often consider freedom of movement, recovery, abrasion by wear zone and the level of weather protection required.
context.technical-apparel: Technical apparel requirements depend on garment design and intended use. Share target performance, construction, weight and finishing needs to shape material development.
context.workwear: Workwear fabric requirements vary by job, environment and garment. Share the conditions of use, durability priorities and any applicable evaluation requirements.

performanceDetail.bodySuffix: Fabric layers, fiber selection, finishing and garment construction all influence how a textile performs in use.
performanceDetail.bodyEnd: During development, define the required targets and applicable evaluation method with your product team. YIPAI can discuss fabric directions against your brief; no specific performance result is implied until agreed and evaluated.
performanceDetail.ctaText: Tell us your application, performance targets and preferred evaluation method.
